# Tutorial Overview

This **self-paced tutorial** is intended to take X hours to complete.

The tutorial is split into the following sections:

1.  **FOUNDATIONS OF DATA PROTECTION**(FOUNDATION) talks about data protection basic in ethics and law, mechanisms of data protection in research, and foundational terms.
2.  [**DATA ANONYMIZATION PROCESS**](ANONYMIZATION) walks you then through the process of anonymizing your research data based on example data.
3. [**BALANCING DATA PROTECTION AND OPENNESS**](BALANCING) closes this tutorial by providing tips on aligning your data protection and open science interests.
